title: Self-contained value streams (independent graph state)
description: Each value stream must be fully self-contained with its own nodes and edges, stored independently in localStorage via the value-stream-store. The graph-store is refactored to load/unload a specific stream rather than persisting a single global graph. An auto-save subscription writes graph changes back to the value-stream-store with debouncing. Streams are not dependent on one another.
